title: Agreement among PPG respiratory modulations identifies lower-error rate windows in record-held-out BIDMC data
abstract: In 53 public BIDMC ICU waveform recordings, agreement among three PPG-derived respiratory modulation frequencies identified lower-error 32-s PPG respiratory-rate windows. A threshold selected in records 01–27 yielded a confirmation-record error difference of 1.53 bpm (95% bootstrap interval 0.43–2.83) between high- and low-disagreement strata. This is limited to internal record-held-out validation, not external-dataset or clinical validation.
